posts.title: Intimate communion: Awakening your sexual essence
posts.description: This is a third year when I'm rereading this book, and I'm much more critical of it this time. I generally agree with the three-level concept: dependent, equal, and intimate communion. However, the author's description of the latter is too abstract. In short, he means it as: love from your heart, give your love, and don't expect anything back. I would suggest The Mastery of Love book instead now.

posts.title: Get Growing: A No-Nonsense Guide to Cultivating Wealth and Financial Freedom
posts.description: The book is not for me. I read a third of it as I was going to the author's book tour event and wanted to get a sense. Looks like the author is trying to appeal to the feminist audience. While the purpose of the book is to give financial education to women, it keeps reinforcing the victim mentality, and feminist talk distracts from the main message.
